unit: one fixed-scope engagement = one action (candidate mapping)
selection_rule: Published prices on the vendor's own page for a fixed-scope small-business AI governance/risk/readiness assessment of comparable scope (workflow/risk inventory, prioritized plan, findings review). Excluded: single sessions and idea sprints under one week ($49, $75, $225 Contra listings) and enterprise programs ($12,500+).

comparables.name: Continuous — AI Risk & Readiness Assessment (NIST AI RMF; flat one-time fee; 1-2 weeks)
Contra listing — Practical AI workflow audit for small businesses (risk & control-gap assessment, remediation plan; 1-2 weeks)
BlueShore.AI — AI Readiness Assessment (risk & opportunity matrix, roadmap, readout; 2-3 days)
Earley Information Science — AI Readiness Quick Check (first report)
Netrix Global — AI readiness assessment (stated typical engagement value; 2-3 weeks)
